Own, immutable CA-06 regression corpus. See `docs/qa/CA244_CONTINUE.md` for exact source and authentication. `deals` contains complete own definitions; `positions` references them and preserves exact exhausted full state plus the original SHA256 chain `SHA256(JSON.stringify([SHA256(JSON.stringify([initial.tableau,initial.stock,initial.foundations,initial.faceUp,initial.hitapps])),board]))`. Baseline and candidate paths/statuses are prior evidence, not a mathematical claim about UNKNOWN cases. The original research suffix `-mN` is a budget-control ID; browser tests remove only this final suffix to load the retained ordinary L200 definition.
